name: Stop tracking app launches for Start and search
description: Turns off 'Let Windows improve Start and search results by tracking app launches' (Settings > Privacy & security > General) by setting Start_TrackProgs = 0 (REG_DWORD) in HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced.
rationale: Windows stops recording which apps the user launches for Start and search personalization, reducing locally collected usage history.
effects: Windows no longer tracks app launches to personalize Start and search results.
sideEffects: Start no longer shows a list of most used apps, and 'Show most used apps' in Settings > Personalization > Start cannot be turned on while tracking is off.
Search results are no longer ranked by how often apps are launched.
notes: Windows default: the setting is on (Start_TrackProgs = 1 or not set).
Per-user preference; no Administrator rights are needed. Included in Lean rather than Safe because it removes a visible Start feature.

references.title: Microsoft Learn - Manage connections from Windows operating system components to Microsoft services, 18.1 General (Start_TrackProgs)
